values./results/@20CBt32dv4GIotEC/description: The characters trigger a cave-in, environmental purge, lethal countermeasures, or similar calamity that affects the entire vault. They must escape.
values./results/@YIOFkvhFHpQVal3C/description: A party of 7-12 human raiders on a mission for a faction important to the overall campaign. Roll d20: 1-5, the faction is friendly, 16-20 they are hostile. Other results mean a neutral or unknown faction.
values./results/@dhHjSE9gGEv6xpaK/description: A squad of 2-4 mutants who immediately attack. Roll d20. On a 1-4, includes at least one super mutant.
values./results/@jMMIeG9QZDeBXF6k/description: A group of security robots appropriate to this vault, on patrol with orders to exterminate or capture intruders
values./results/@qoxasauTKoQXBgnR/description: Signs of a battle between the dead humans and something large and probably hungry. An appropriate test uncovers a number of days’ worth of clean water and good food equal to the number of successes.
values./results/@0FWlYyooCCLAweOU/description: Three times the party in number, they swarm across the room biting everything in their path.
values./results/@dAYTGIBNah8uiusD/description: Giant Radscorpions, Giant Ants, or Mirelurks, in numbers equal to the party.
values./results/@JF3ogUn0IaBZ5XaV/description: A rampaging pack of 2-4 feral ghouls spring from the shadows. Roll d20. On a 1-4, the pack includes a roamer or Reaver.
values./results/@Eh3XUoU0AYLRCHyR/description: Roll twice. The results of both rolls are locked in mortal combat against each other, ignoring the player characters entirely.
